answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the glacier of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a formal notation where applicable, precise language register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution. A vine of per-task receipts records who did what, and the knoll of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
